text: Artificial intelligence is becoming more common in our daily lives, from job applications to medical diagnoses. However, this raises important ethical questions. One major issue is bias. If AI is trained on unfair or incomplete data, it can make decisions that discriminate against certain groups. Fairness means ensuring that AI treats all people equally. Another key concern is privacy: AI systems often collect large amounts of personal data, which must be handled carefully to protect individuals. Transparency is also crucial—people should understand how AI reaches its decisions. Ultimately, responsible AI development requires companies and governments to consider these ethical issues from the beginning, not as an afterthought.
